text:
Marta: Quick sync — proposing two small additions to runtime config to make rollouts safe for routing+quota: a numeric scope_priority and a preview_only flag. Opening RFC after quick 👍/👎.

Devin: can you sketch the failure mode? why do we need priority?

Marta: TL;DR: right now route selection can happen after a config override is applied, which means quota lookup sometimes uses the pre-override routing key. Result: quota mis-attribution + telemetry gaps. Example: tenant T gets preview -> routed to latency pool -> quota charged to default pool.

Samir: saw that in billing dash last week — we had a tenant showing spikes in two buckets. :confused:

Marta: Proposed behavior: evaluator computes the effective_route_key deterministically from the merged config (including preview overrides) before any quota/route accounting. scope_priority is used during merge to resolve collisions between multiple overlapping rules. preview_only prevents a config from touching live quota buckets unless telemetry gate is satisfied.

Eli: audit question — we must persist both input config and the resolved effective_route_key + config_version in the audit log. Ops needs this for forensic rollbacks.

Shweta: Console UX: show a line in the preview modal that says "Effective route: <pool> (resolved from rule X)" plus a small diff vs current route. Also a telemetry-gate checkbox that blocks promote unless latency/error metrics are green.

Marta: agreed. Implementation notes: runtime schema v2 will accept scope_priority:int and preview_only:bool. We'll accept previewFlag alias for backward-compat. We'll add validator that rejects preview_only=true for rules with non-zero immediate_quota unless telemetry_gate set.

ops-bot: @ops-bot staging-validator › schema check failed in canary: unknown field "preview_only" in config v1.

Marta: thanks — plan: add schema version guard and migration path. For staging rollout we'll include feature-gate header so old runtimes ignore new fields.

Devin: include unit tests that assert quota attribution uses resolved effective_route_key, integration test that toggles preview_only + telemetry_gate.

Samir: what about rollbacks? if a promoted config is reverted, do we need a compensating quota transfer?

Marta: we should not move historical quota. Instead we'll emit a reconciliation event that flags mismatches and an ops command to reassign counters if customer requests it. Document this in runbook.

Shweta: also add a console notice when you promote a preview that says "This change will be reflected in quota aggregation from the moment of promote. Historical metrics not moved."

Eli: +1 on storing resolved keys in audit logs. Also capture which runtime version did the resolution.

Marta: I'll open the RFC + PR today. Patch plan: 1) schema + validator, 2) evaluator change (resolve before quota), 3) console preview line + telemetry gate UI, 4) audit updates, 5) tests + rollout plan with feature-gate header.

Devin: cool. ping when PR is up, I'll review for API clarity.

Samir: ping me for runbook and metrics queries.

Marta: will do. :rocket:
